name: Kor Nijiladii; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Kor Nijiladii represented by the number 5)
description: Kor Nijiladii was a world located within the Kor Nijiladii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Hestilic system.
lead_paragraphs: Kor Nijiladii was a world located within the Kor Nijiladii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Hestilic system.
Kor Nijiladii was the throneworld of the Nijiladii kajidic.
